query: uh supervisor not paying my overtime wages since three months saying no budget available uh what labour office to go

model_output.summary: Your supervisor has not paid your overtime wages for the past three months, using a lack of budget as the reason. Under the law, employers are responsible for paying all wages on time. You can approach the Labour Commissioner's office to file a claim for your delayed wages.
facts_extracted: Employer has not paid overtime wages for three months
Reason given by supervisor is no budget available
Employee is seeking which labour office to visit

options.title: File a Claim at the Labour Office
options.description: You can file an application before the appointed Authority or Labour Commissioner to claim your delayed wages.
pros: Official process to recover unpaid wages
Authority can order payment of delayed wages along with compensation
cons: May take time to resolve through official channels
options.forum: Labour Commissioner Office / Payment of Wages Authority

citations.relevance: States that every employer is responsible for paying all wages required to be paid to the employed persons.
Allows an employee whose wages are delayed to file an application before the Labour Commissioner to recover delayed wages and compensation.

missing_info: Name and location of the establishment
Exact amount of overtime wages due
